spatial.requiredIndex: GiST on the canonical candidate location geography
spatial.hydrationRule: exact spatial eligibility is decided before full canonical payload hydration where the backend candidate representation permits it

identifierLookup.semantics: global identifier candidates are unioned with spatial candidates and are not discarded for distance

designationReferenceLookup.semantics: global designation-reference candidates are unioned with spatial candidates

governance.crossSource: retain when spatially eligible or globally identified
governance.matcherAuthority: the governed matcher remains the identity/scoring authority; SQL only produces candidates

productionEquivalentSqlTemplate.spatial: SELECT c.* FROM candidate_index c WHERE ST_DWithin(c.location, ST_SetSRID(ST_Point(:lng, :lat), 4326)::geography, :radius_m)
productionEquivalentSqlTemplate.identifiers: SELECT c.* FROM candidate_identifier_index c WHERE c.identifier_value = ANY(:identifier_values)
productionEquivalentSqlTemplate.designationReferences: SELECT c.* FROM candidate_designation_reference_index c WHERE c.reference_value = ANY(:designation_reference_values)
productionEquivalentSqlTemplate.final: UNION DISTINCT the three candidate streams, apply the shared same-register predicate, order by insertion_sequence, then hydrate and invoke the matcher

schemaGap.description: The current public schema has places.location, place_designations.reference and source_records(source_id, external_id), but no dedicated compact candidate index exposing sourceRecordId, designation identities, identifier/reference lookup keys and canonical insertion sequence as one efficient backend contract.
schemaGap.batch21BAction: design and validate the smallest staging/candidate representation and indexes in a disposable PostGIS database before adding a corrective migration

workUnit.halo: enumerate all cells touched by the 5000m-expanded point envelope; do not hand-code only eight neighbours
